# monero_wallet_backend — Monero Wallet Backend

> Monero wallet coordinator: wallet registry, sync poller, balances and history, send orchestration (build → review → broadcast). Holds no key material.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `configure` | `configure(config_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Name who holds the two roles: `{ approvers?, custodians? }` → `{ ok, approvers, custodians }`. |
| `caller_identity` | `caller_identity() -> tstr` | `{ ok, kind, identity, approvers, custodians }` — who this call authenticated as, and who holds the roles. |
| `list_networks` | `list_networks() -> tstr` | `{ ok, networks: [...], active }`. |
| `set_active_network` | `set_active_network(network: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `list_wallets` | `list_wallets() -> tstr` | `{ ok, wallets: [{ name, network, label, viewOnly, restoreHeight, address }] }` — the registry merged with what the engine finds on disk; unverified files have network="". |
| `open_wallet` | `open_wallet(name: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `create_wallet` | `create_wallet(name: tstr, password: tstr, label: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `restore_from_seed` | `restore_from_seed(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | `params_json`: `{ name, password, seed, restoreHeight, seedOffset?, label? }` → `{ ok, jobId }`. |
| `restore_from_keys` | `restore_from_keys(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | `params_json`: `{ name, password, address, viewKey, spendKey?, restoreHeight, label? }` → `{ ok, jobId }`. |
| `close_wallet` | `close_wallet() -> tstr` | `{ ok, jobId }`. |
| `change_password` | `change_password(old_password: tstr, new_password: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `reveal_seed` | `reveal_seed(password: tstr) -> tstr` | Pass-through to the engine, which re-checks the password. |
| `reveal_view_key` | `reveal_view_key(password: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `job_status` | `job_status(job_id: tstr) -> tstr` | `{ ok, state: queued¦running¦done¦failed, result?, error? }` for a backend job id. |
| `wallet_status` | `wallet_status() -> tstr` | The engine's status plus `syncPercent` and the registry's meta for the open wallet. |
| `balances` | `balances(account_index: int) -> tstr` | `{ ok, balance, unlocked, balanceXmr, unlockedXmr }` — atomic units as decimal strings. |
| `receive_info` | `receive_info(account_index: int) -> tstr` | `{ ok, address, subaddresses: [{ index, address, label }] }`. |
| `create_subaddress` | `create_subaddress(account_index: int, label: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `set_subaddress_label` | `set_subaddress_label(account_index: int, address_index: int, label: tstr) -> tstr` | Rename a subaddress, or clear the label with an empty string. |
| `history` | `history() -> tstr` | `{ ok, rows: [...] }`, newest first, amounts as decimal strings + XMR strings. |
| `address_valid` | `address_valid(address: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `node_health` | `node_health() -> tstr` | The node module's health for the active network. |
| `node_config` | `node_config() -> tstr` | The active network's node config, with the RPC password REDACTED to `hasPassword`. |
| `local_node` | `local_node() -> tstr` | Whether monerod_module can serve the active network: `{ ok, available, rpcUrl?, status?, error? }`. |
| `set_node_config` | `set_node_config(config_json: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `prepare_send` | `prepare_send(send_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Build a transaction for review. |
| `send_status` | `send_status(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | `{ ok, requestId, state: preparing¦previewed¦committing¦sent¦failed¦cancelled, preview?, txids?, error? }`. |
| `list_sends` | `list_sends() -> tstr` | `{ ok, sends: [{ requestId, state }] }` — every request not yet acked away; what a headless approver polls to find previews awaiting a decision. |
| `confirm_send` | `confirm_send(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | APPROVER. |
| `cancel_send` | `cancel_send(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `format_xmr` | `format_xmr(atomic: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `parse_xmr` | `parse_xmr(xmr: tstr) -> tstr` |  |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_state_changed` | `wallet_state_changed(payload: tstr)` | The engine's state moved; payload is wallet_status()'s shape. |
| `sync_progress` | `sync_progress(payload: tstr)` | `{ walletHeight, daemonHeight, percent, synchronized }`, on every change. |
| `balance_changed` | `balance_changed(payload: tstr)` | `{ balance, unlocked }` for account 0, on every change. |
| `send_status_changed` | `send_status_changed(request_id: tstr, state: tstr)` |  |
| `job_finished` | `job_finished(job_id: tstr, state: tstr)` |  |
